title: Instant Experience
description: This mod enables you to instantly get XP from mobs without having to collect the orbs!
body:
This mod enables you to instantly get XP from mobs without having to collect the orbs!

There is an obvious flaw in long-ranged weapons in minecraft. After killing the mob, getting XP from it is pretty annoying. Another thing that's annoying about XP: it tends to slip away from you if there's a lot of it. This proves most annoying when collecting XP from the Ender Dragon.

But if you have this mod in your mod folder, there will be no more of running after XP orbs! This mod checks your surroundings for any XP orbs, and if there are, instantly adds them to your XP bar. This means you'll have a satisfying amount of levels in a blink of the eye after killing the dragon!

Note: This mod might take a few seconds for large amounts of XP (ex: the Ender Dragon's XP).
